brief:
A former Palestinian detainee has accused an Israeli prison guard of slapping her and tearing off her hijab, Middle East Eye reported. The allegation forms part of a broader pattern of mistreatment documented by former prisoners who say Israeli facilities routinely strip women of headscarves and deny them prayer clothing.

The former detainee's account points to systematic practices in Israeli prisons targeting Palestinian women's religious observance and dignity during detention.

title: Israeli guard assaults Palestinian detainee, tears off hijab
